preRedCommit.note: test-only commit before RED: entry-panel mint fixtures made valid for the shared adapter (LS10 rewrite-first set). The amended entry file passes 24/24 at the baseline and at the sizing draft, so none of those 24 tests is a RED failure.

inertStub.note: New registered leaf, present only as an inert stub (both exports render null) so component tests fail on assertions rather than on a missing module; the GREEN commit replaces it. Disclosed as the admission redPlan allows.

summary: 51 behavioral failures in the two owned suites against the unchanged product bytes (CampaignCoopEntryPanel.tsx and CampaignNavigation.tsx hash-equal to baseline; LocalSeatCredentialPanel.tsx an inert stub). Every failure is a runtime assertion (missing region/combobox/label/button, wrong request, wrong message, input not cleared); there is no missing module, import error, TypeError or suite-load failure. The 5 new tests that pass are preserve or hosting tests whose evidence is a mutant kill at GREEN; 24 are the existing fixture-amended entry tests.
